additional_info.subject: ID0477374-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312571675/11] Charging Failure - Cable Check CRM:03209000170
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0477374
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Engie Vianeo
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / PN 312571675/11
Charger ID / Serial No.:
QdCGi1
Charger address/functional location: France
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: on -site check
Following the report of the client, the charger cable needs to be checked.
Client tells us that there has been a new cable installed on outlet 2, but after the installation all the charging sessions has been failing after stage P03 Cable check.
The first load test took place on February 7 at 1:31 p.m. (French time) which failed.  Before the cable was replaced, the charging point was working fine.
We kindly ask you to check the installation of the cable on outlet 2 following the protocol check, and to bring an CCS cable in case the cable needs replacement. I will attach the reference for the CCS cable for this specific charger.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com

.

Thank you.

additional_info.subject: 0477374 - ID0477374-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312571675/11] Charging Failure - Cable Check CRM:00472000567
additional_info.body:
Hello Franck,
When we have failures during the cablecheck that the contactors have feedback OFF, the fault is not the contactor. Most of the times the problem is on state monitor.
See the schematic below:
The "close output contactors" command is done via PLC but the output goes directly to state monitor (here is represented as KF13 but you can use KF14 because charger is dual CCS).
The state monitor control the safety part of the charging session so have the last command in the output contactors. When the state monitor is defective the output to the contactors coil is not done and fail during the cablecheck because is the first instance where we close the output contactors.
Please replace the state monitor. I will send this ticket back to your queue.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
mailto:joao.louro-cardoso@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
